characters.Kai: src/anim/cast.py KAI - lucky red Hawaiian shirt, shorts, flip-flops; works at the boardwalk surf shop
characters.Tess: 15, customer, dark ponytail, yellow hoodie, brave but scared, has never surfed
characters.The infected: grey-green skin, torn clothes, white eyes, slow then fast; they will not go into water

scenes.narration: ~Paddle out? The glass is breaking. Forty infected are inside. And Kai and Tess are running for the ocean.
scenes.visual: glass bursts, Kai and Tess run out the back, PADDLE OUT?

scenes.narration: They hit the sand running. The infected poured out of the shop behind them.
scenes.visual: beach at night, the infected chasing

scenes.narration: Kai threw the boards into the water. Lie on it. Paddle. Don't look back.
scenes.visual: Kai pushing Tess's board into the waves

scenes.narration: They looked back. The infected stopped at the waterline. Moaning. Watching. Not one step further.
scenes.visual: the infected lined up at the water, white eyes

scenes.narration: Tess laughed. Then she cried. They had made it.
scenes.visual: Tess on her board, crying and laughing

scenes.narration: Then the water started moving. Fast. Pulling them out to sea.
scenes.visual: the water rushing outward, the beach shrinking

scenes.narration: A rip current. A river of water running straight out from the beach.
scenes.visual: diagram: arrows pulling out from the shore

scenes.narration: Tess panicked. She turned around and paddled straight back toward the beach. As hard as she could.
scenes.visual: Tess paddling hard toward shore, not moving
the infected waiting on the sand

scenes.narration: Stop, Kai shouted. You can't fight it. Nobody can.
Here is the rule that saves lives every summer. If a rip current grabs you, don't fight it. Swim sideways, along the beach. Then come in.
scenes.visual: RULE card: DON'T FIGHT IT / GO SIDEWAYS / THEN COME IN

scenes.narration: So they paddled sideways. Parallel to the shore. Arms burning.
scenes.visual: both paddling sideways, the beach sliding past

scenes.narration: The infected walked with them along the sand. Matching every stroke.
scenes.visual: the crowd walking along the shore, keeping pace

scenes.narration: Then the current let go. The water went calm.
Kai's board bumped into something in the dark.
A man. Floating face down. Wearing a lifeguard shirt.
scenes.visual: a floating figure next to the board

scenes.narration: Then the man's hand closed around Kai's ankle.
Kick free? Tell me in the comments. Part three is up next.
